label: pretending
title_raw: わざとらしい [わざとらしい] (pretending)
title: わざとらしい
meaning_example: it seems like he is faking his injury

notes.text:
I ran into this grammar in a song I was translating.



it is a set phrase, using わざと　meaning intentionaly and らしい it appears or it seems. to imply that what ever the case may be, it is being faked. 



this is the kind of Japanese that is best wispered that spoken. 使ったら気を付けってね
